[Bioinformatics Data Scientist]{.exp-title}  
[IDIBELL — Oncology Data Analytics Program (ODAP) · L'Hospitalet de Llobregat, Spain]{.exp-org}
:::
[Jul 2022 – Present]{.exp-date}
:::
- Developed automated, reproducible R/Python bioinformatics pipelines for large-scale NGS data (WGS, RNA-seq, WGBS, microbiome), including preprocessing, QC, analysis, and multi-omics integration
- Analysed genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and metagenomic datasets to identify genotype–phenotype associations, regulatory patterns, and cancer-related biomarkers
- Applied statistical modelling and machine learning (Random Forest, LASSO, PCA, SVM, Bayesian models) to prioritise candidate biomarkers from high-dimensional multi-omics datasets
- Performed genotype imputation, GWAS, and large-scale genomic analyses using 1000 Genomes and TOPMed reference panels with strict QC and population genetics validation
- Collaborated with clinicians, experimental researchers, and data scientists to interpret results and support scientific publications
:::
